description: SURFACED (and independently confirmed) by the fz-go4.54 adversarial audit while verifying the GroundValue::EmptyList deletion. native_codegen/receive.rs: ReceiveValue::Null's sole constructor is dispatch_const_receive_value's 'ValueKind::NULL => ReceiveValue::Null' arm (~receive.rs:1211). But dispatch_const_value -- the function producing the GroundValueBits fed into it -- has NO arm that ever emits ValueKind::NULL: its six arms (Int/Float/Atom/Bool/Nil/Utf8Binary) map to INT/FLOAT/ATOM/ATOM/ATOM/None only. So ReceiveValue::Null is structurally dead by the EXACT same mechanism GroundValue::EmptyList/DispatchShape::EmptyList were (fz-go4.54). Pre-existing (predates fz-yj0/fz-iib/fz-go4.54), left untouched there to keep that commit's scope to the empty-list fold. Reduce win: trace the full producer chain to confirm no live path, then delete ReceiveValue::Null + its dead arms (exhaustive-by-construction, no catch-all). Related: fz-go4.54, fz-iib.
